stem: Plant debris has accumulated beneath benches in a production room. No active pest is confirmed. Why should the debris still be removed on schedule?
choices: Debris removal matters only for appearance
Plant debris can provide shelter, food, moisture or inoculum that increases future pest and disease risk
Debris is harmless until a pesticide application is scheduled
Removing debris eliminates the need for routine scouting
rationale: Sanitation is preventive. Organic debris can support pest or pathogen persistence before an outbreak is confirmed.
